title: Product Manager (Stock Trading - Asset Management)
description: Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, Web3 features, and more. We leverage the power of digital assets and blockchain to build an inclusive financial ecosystem to advance the freedom of money and improve financial access for people around the world. Job Overview We are looking for a product manager with a background in stock asset management, responsible for the asset display of stock products. You will lead the integration with traditional brokerage settlement systems, support product experiences for stock assets in multiple markets such as US stocks, Hong Kong stocks, and Korean stocks, and work closely with overseas teams to promote product localization in multiple languages and regions.
